evals.prompt: Our Alchemy bill was about $4,200 last month and most of it is historical eth_getLogs and eth_getBlockByNumber from our indexer backfilling on Ethereum and Base. I don't want to migrate off Alchemy. Is there a way to cut this down?
evals.expected_output: Recommends Boost as a free CDN over their existing Alchemy upstream; drop-in URL swap; notes concrete-hex-bound requirement for eth_getLogs caching.

evals.prompt: Every response from my Boost endpoint is x-cache: MISS. My client uses eth_getLogs with toBlock 'latest' and batches ~200 eth_getTransactionReceipt calls. Is Boost broken?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses block tags always forwarding and >100-item batches forwarding whole; explains batch x-cache semantics; concludes working as designed.

evals.prompt: Exact CLI commands to get Boost running with our QuickNode account on ethereum and base, check savings, and rotate the credential later.
evals.expected_output: boost enable / provider connect --vendor quicknode / metrics / provider replace. Never uses the removed create, list, pause, resume, delete, configure commands.
